hints: A round is needed whenever some value has to be collected before a smaller value that is currently earlier in the row.
Record each number's position; values 1..n can be collected in one pass when pos[v]>pos[v+1].
The number of rounds is one plus the number of such breaks.
analogy: You can collect the next number in the same sweep only if its location is to the right of the previous number.
example: For 4,2,1,5,3, positions decrease at 1->2 and 2->3, so 3 rounds are needed.
algorithm: Build position[value], then count 1 plus every v from 1 to n-1 with position[v]>position[v+1].
correctness: Within a round the collector scans left to right; exactly the position descents force a return to the beginning.
